messages:
sam: Quick sync: a couple Expo users hit runtime errors and TS issues when installing the JS SDK. Errors: 'crypto.getRandomValues is not a function' and metro failing on 'stream/web'.

anya: Yep. Metro resolved our ESM entry and pulled in stream/web. On RN that's bad. We should add a react-native export so bundlers pick a RN-safe bundle.

ryan: Agreed. Proposed minimal package.json exports: 
{ ".": { "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs", "react-native": "./dist/rn/index.js" } }
That should make Metro prefer dist/rn.

mike: Also runtime: retries clone request body which crashes on RN fetch. We need to change retry logic to buffer non-stream bodies and throw a clear error for stream bodies (tell user to pass string/json).

sam: Types too: current .d.ts references Node Buffer and ReadableStream. RN projects then pull @types/node. Let's ship a dist/rn/index.d.ts that uses Uint8Array and avoids Node types. Map it in exports/types if possible.

anya: Short-term README snippet for Expo users: install 'react-native-get-random-values' (or expo-random) and add at top of App.js: 
import 'react-native-get-random-values';
if (!globalThis.crypto) { globalThis.crypto = { getRandomValues: global.getRandomValues }; }
Plus note about non-cloneable request bodies.

ryan: I'll open a small PR for the exports + RN bundle and add a runtime check that logs missing globals: crypto, ReadableStream, AbortController.

ci-bot: Created DEVEX-5199: "RN/Expo compatibility: react-native export, retry fix, RN types, example" assigned to ryan, anya, sam. ETA 5 days.

mike: I'll take retry changes and add unit test simulating clone failure. Also add CI smoke test that resolves dist/rn with metro-resolver.

sam: Thanks team. Let's keep the RN build minimal (no node builtins) and add an examples/expo-minimal for onboarding.

anya: I'll draft README troubleshooting and the one-file expo example.

sam: Perfect. Small deliverables so we can unblock users quickly. :rocket:
